metrics_finding.finding: user-service CPU utilization increased significantly during the failure window, from 0.00853 to 0.6668266666666667, while other services' CPU utilization remained stable.

evidence_summary.summary: User-service CPU utilization increased significantly during the failure window, from 0.00853 to 0.6668266666666667, while other services' CPU utilization remained stable.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be a significant increase in user-service CPU utilization during the failure window. Further investigation is recommended to confirm this finding.
report_text.hi: अप्रत्याशित घटना के मुख्य कारण विशिष्ट उपयोगकर्ता-सेवा सीपीयू लागत में महत्वपूर्ण वृद्धि होने की संभावना है। अतिरिक्त जांच करने की आवश्यकता है ताकि यह पाया जा सके कि यह खोज मिली।
